purpose: Define `#INPUT:*` as a dynamic namespace family for explicit input-source instances, where each child identity is validated and owned by an Input module without allowing arbitrary root creation.

topics.name: #INPUT Dynamic Namespace Family
topics.purpose: Define `#INPUT:*` as a dynamic namespace family for explicit input-source instances, where each child identity is validated and owned by an Input module without allowing arbitrary root creation.

semantics.child_rule: Each `#INPUT:<id>` child has an explicit instance/source identity.
semantics.owner_rule: Child namespace is owned by its declared Input module/source instance.
semantics.payload_rule: Input payload written under the child namespace remains inert data.
semantics.creation_rule: Dynamic child creation requires valid family membership and exact non-colliding child identity.
semantics.escape_rule: Dynamic child identity cannot escape into another reserved root or create nested arbitrary top-level namespaces.
semantics.lifecycle_rule: Runtime child availability/state may change without redefining the family contract.
semantics.authority_rule: Writing input data does not imply permission to execute operations.

invariants.rule: Runtime symbol namespaces, roots, mounts and dynamic families are explicit, collision-free and never inferred solely from filesystem layout or display labels.

hard_gates.condition: dynamic child identity collides with reserved root
child namespace has no explicit owning Input source
dynamic child resolved from untrusted payload without validation

references.purpose: Input namespaces carry validated inert input data.
